provenance: lpdf-geom HatchEngine::Cadcraft (cadcraft@df65974 cadcraft-doc library + patched cadcraft-render pattern_lines), same cases as hatch_legacy.golden.json
parity: Every case differs from legacy by design: ERR-007 fixed (segments are clipped to the loop, even-odd) and each pattern id maps to a distinct cadcraft family set (ANSI31, ANSI32, ANSI37, NET, BRICK, custom timber, EARTH, ZIGZAG, AR-CONC). Scale keeps the legacy 0.25..4 clamp; 1 = 64 pt per pattern unit (ANSI 0.125 -> 8 pt; AR-CONC, defined 16x coarser upstream, uses 4).
